title.zh: 将新比斯开省杜帕克斯市镇的市政所在地从现址迁移至该市镇马拉萨因村的法案
title.en: An Act to Transfer the Municipal Site of the Municipality of Dupax, Province of Nueva Vizcaya, from its Present Location to the Barrio of Malasin of the Said Municipality
title.orig: An Act to Transfer the Municipal Site of the Municipality of Dupax, Province of Nueva Vizcaya, from its Present Location to the Barrio of Malasin of the Said Municipality
title.vi: Đạo luật Chuyển Địa Điểm Trụ Sở Hành Chính Của Thành Phố Trực Thuộc Tỉnh Dupax, Tỉnh Nueva Vizcaya Từ Địa Điểm Hiện Tại Đến Barangay Malasin Của Thành Phố Này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติย้ายสถานที่สำนักงานเทศบาลของเทศบาลดูปากซ์จังหวัด nuevavizcaya จากสถานที่ปัจจุบันไปยังบารังไกย์มาลาซินของเทศบาลดังกล่าว
title.id: Undang-Undang Memindahkan Lokasi Kantor Pemerintah Kota Dupax, Provinsi Nueva Vizcaya dari Lokasi Saat Ini ke Desa Malasin dari Kota Tersebut
title.ms: Akta Memindahkan Lokasi Pejabat Perbandaran Dupax, Wilayah Nueva Vizcaya dari Lokasi Semasa ke Kampung Malasin bagi Perbandaran Tersebut

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1181_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The municipal site of the municipality of Dupax, province of Nueva Vizcaya, is transferred from its present location to the barrio of Malasin of the said municipality.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1954.
